title: galeopsis angustifolia subsp. carpetana
intro: Galeopsis angustifolia subsp. carpetana, commonly known as Small Blue Whortle, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including colds, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Galeopsis angustifolia subsp. carpetana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids are responsible for its therapeutic effects, although more research is needed to fully understand its properties.
